kasv_4be3b45e347a46169a6fa592bcdfe00d.era: Around the 7th century BCE (2524 BCE - 258 BCE)
kasv_4be3b45e347a46169a6fa592bcdfe00d.description: The first nation-building period of the Vietnamese people, closely associated with the legendary Hùng Kings, Lạc Long Quân and Âu Cơ. A brilliant civilization represented by the Đông Sơn Bronze Drum — an enduring cultural symbol.

kasv_b7c018a1616c42ac9073368b9e001470.era: Around the 3rd century BCE (258 BCE - 208 BCE)
kasv_b7c018a1616c42ac9073368b9e001470.artifact: Liên Châu Crossbow - Cổ Loa Magic Crossbow
kasv_b7c018a1616c42ac9073368b9e001470.description: An Dương Vương unified the Âu Việt and Lạc Việt peoples, building the legendary spiral-shaped Cổ Loa Citadel. The story of the magic crossbow and Mỵ Châu - Trọng Thủy remains an eternal lesson about vigilance.

kasv_fdd63a242a4d43bd846f1c09eb5b0f6f.artifact: Bạch Đằng Wooden Stake Battlefield Diorama
kasv_fdd63a242a4d43bd846f1c09eb5b0f6f.description: Ngô Quyền crushed the Southern Han army on the Bạch Đằng River in 938, ending over 1,000 years of Chinese domination. This resounding victory laid the foundation for an era of national independence.

kasv_542c8726aed941a6ab40ceae371819ee.description: Lê Đại Hành succeeded the Đinh Dynasty, bravely defeating the invading Song army, protecting the young independence, and expanding territory southward.

kasv_90ba8e957f584ff99df9209f16a626d4.artifact: "Đại Việt Quốc Quân Thành Chuyên" Brick
kasv_90ba8e957f584ff99df9209f16a626d4.description: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh suppressed the Twelve Warlords rebellion, unifying the country and becoming Emperor, establishing the nation name Đại Cồ Việt — Vietnam's first official national title.

kasv_db3e2121d18c44739f0720b0f59310b7.description: Lý Công Uẩn moved the capital to Thăng Long, opening a golden age. Buddhism flourished, ceramic arts, pagoda architecture, and the Lý Dragon became immortal symbols.

kasv_8fc4f5bf04b14e8c8b70f543ca8b6235.era: Inspired by the seal system under the Trần Dynasty, 13th-14th century (1225-1400 CE)
kasv_8fc4f5bf04b14e8c8b70f543ca8b6235.description: Three triumphant victories against the Mongol-Yuan forces under the leadership of Trần Hưng Đạo. The Spirit of Đông A resonated through history, and the Proclamation to Officers remains an immortal literary masterpiece.

kasv_7cdd1a74a27347779c3f3f7bc7b69c35.description: Hồ Quý Ly enacted bold reforms: issuing paper currency, reforming education, building the massive stone Tây Đô Citadel. Though brief, the Hồ Dynasty left a uniquely remarkable architectural legacy.

kasv_51783bb4502e431a8537bb549b69345d.era: 1467 CE, during Emperor Lê Thánh Tông's reign (1428-1527 CE)
kasv_51783bb4502e431a8537bb549b69345d.artifact: Stone Dragon of Kính Thiên Palace Stairway
kasv_51783bb4502e431a8537bb549b69345d.description: Lê Lợi led the 10-year Lam Sơn Uprising, liberating the country from Ming Dynasty rule. Nguyễn Trãi composed the Bình Ngô Đại Cáo — the second Declaration of Independence.

kasv_2dd2f9fa988a4d85b110f540a85b1dd9.artifact: Brown and Gray-Blue Glazed Ceramic Incense Burner
kasv_2dd2f9fa988a4d85b110f540a85b1dd9.description: Mạc Đăng Dung established the Mạc Dynasty, initiating the Southern-Northern Courts period. Despite controversy, the Mạc Dynasty left lasting marks in architecture, ceramics, and prosperous trade.

kasv_0722f40301894ab2916cb444b53f6ceb.era: Approximately 16th-18th centuries CE, especially 1533 to late 18th century
kasv_0722f40301894ab2916cb444b53f6ceb.description: The era of Lê Kings and Trịnh Lords ruling Đàng Ngoài (the Outer Realm). Real power lay in the hands of the Trịnh Lords while the Lê Kings held symbolic roles. Military technology advanced significantly with royal cannons.

kasv_6a8685ed51344e7abea0b5c739c82fef.description: The Nguyễn Lords expanded southward, building Đàng Trong (the Inner Realm) into a prosperous land. A powerful navy with large warships, and thriving international trade through Hội An port.

kasv_0840bd5eb40547659c7993c2d8996449.era: Late 18th century, associated with the Tây Sơn movement and the Ngọc Hồi - Đống Đa Victory in 1789.
kasv_0840bd5eb40547659c7993c2d8996449.description: Hero Quang Trung - Nguyễn Huệ unified the country, crushing 290,000 Qing troops in the lightning Spring campaign of 1789 — one of the greatest victories in history.

kasv_3efc1d2799544146b60243eb7f23aa64.era: 4th year of Minh Mạng's reign (1823 CE)
kasv_3efc1d2799544146b60243eb7f23aa64.description: The last feudal dynasty, Gia Long unified the country and established the capital at Huế. The Huế Court architecture, golden seals, and the Citadel are recognized by UNESCO as World Heritage.

box_bdddc48ec18c4fc998ee351dc0eaa98d.description: Includes: Thái Bình Hưng Bảo Coin, An Dương Vương Magic Crossbow, Đại Việt Quốc Quân Thành Chuyên Brick.

box_575e2155ebbf42ecbc666f32ccc37aab.description: Includes: Royal Cannon, Đàng Trong Warship, Hồ Citadel Stone.

box_0234e6d19b374b35ba13cd3fa9f9d18b.description: Includes: Kính Thiên Palace Stone Dragon, Bạch Đằng Wooden Stake Diorama, Đông Sơn Bronze Drum, Bronze Elephant Teapot, Trần Dynasty Seal, Brown-glazed Incense Burner, Lý Dynasty Dragon Head.
